Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

SF3 Joint Position Limit | setsLimits | upper and lower limits for the allowed joint positions | each joint can have its own limits | Sets upper and lower limits for the allowed joint positions. Each joint can have its own limits.
SF3 Joint Position Limit | isSafetyRatedPer | ISO 10218-1:2011, 5.12.3 | | It is safety-rated soft axis limiting & space limiting, according to ISO 10218-1:2011, 5.12.3.
SF3 Joint Position Limit | initiatesStop | robot stop to prevent exceeding any limit | | A robot stop will be initiated to prevent exceeding any limit.
SF4 Joint Speed Limit | setsUpperLimit | upper limit for the joint speed | each joint can have its own limit | Sets an upper limit for the joint speed. Each joint can have its own limit.
SF4 Joint Speed Limit | hasMostInfluenceOn | energy transfer upon contact (clamping or transient) | | This safety function has the most influence on energy transfer upon contact (clamping or transient).
SF4 Joint Speed Limit | isUsedTo | limit fast joint movements, e.g. risks related to singularities | | It is used to limit fast joint movements, e.g. risks related to singularities.
SF4 Joint Torque Limit | resultsIn | Cat 0 Stop | exceeding the internal joint torque limit (each joint) | Exceeding the internal joint torque limit (each joint) results in a Cat 0 Stop.
SF4 Joint Torque Limit | isNotAccessibleTo | user | it is a factory setting | This safety function is not accessible to the user; it is a factory setting.
SF5 TCP Pose Limit | monitors | TCP pose (position and orientation) and prevents exceeding a safety plane or pose limit | | Monitors the TCP Pose (position and orientation) and will prevent exceeding a safety plane or pose limit.
SF5 TCP Pose Limit | allowsMultiplePoseLimitsAt | tool flange, elbow, and up to 2 configurable tool offset points with a radius | | Multiple pose limits are possible (tool flange, elbow, and up to 2 configurable tool offset points with a radius).
SF5 TCP Orientation Limit | hasTolerance | 3° | deviation from the Z direction of the tool flange or the TCP | Orientation Limit ... 3° ... deviation from the Z direction of the tool flange OR the TCP.
SF5 TCP Pose Limit | restrictsSpeedOrTorques | speed or torques are reduced so motion will not exceed any limit | limit set for SF 5, SF 6, SF 7 or SF 8 | Speed or torques could be reduced so motion will not exceed any limit set for SF 5, SF 6, SF 7 or SF 8.
